notes.title: Game Update
notes.notes:
*Bot Improvements:
Various improvements have been made to in-game bots. Bots are now smarter and more challenging.
   
*Tutorial Addition:
An interactive tutorial has been added for new players. Players can now better learn the fundamentals of the game.
   
*New Card Visuals:
Visuals for cards in the game have been updated. Cards are now more visually appealing and distinctive.
   
*Play Test and Demo:
Various updates have been made to the play test and demo versions of the game. These updates aim to make the gaming experience smoother and include bug fixes.
